source_review: Full Community Feedback #9 and latest released Patch 1.7 publisher text reviewed. Original recent Support replies and surrounding player context reviewed, with exact registered staff identities, current badges and reply hashes checked. Earlier Patch 1.6 text re-read for Catch Up chronology.
scope: Updated bug dossiers, feature plans, current release caveats and three-depth returning-player summaries. Newer reviewed announcements do not become released mechanics; historical source and issue dates are retained.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Bugs & Issues / PS5 Crashes
source_refs.claim: Developers attribute the discussed PS5 crashes to memory exhaustion, not audio, and describe memory improvements in development. No new released fix or universal crash cause is established.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124236763; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support requests diagnostics after a mixed report includes freezes or crashes while firing as a zoomed-in tank gunner. No shared cause with other crashes is confirmed.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679810651840623; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support continues diagnostic troubleshooting of the reported water-exit and tank performance problems. No resolved outcome is recorded.

source_refs.title: 1 hour of gameplay than constant amd crashes
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679770568959998; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support continues case-specific AMD crash troubleshooting and raises drivers or hardware as possibilities, not a confirmed diagnosis. No game-wide crash fix is established.

source_refs.title: game crash nvidia geforcenow and other
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124237769; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: For a GeForce NOW crash report, Support says assistance with cloud or remote play is limited and refers the player to Nvidia. This is a Support-scope statement, not evidence of a general service outage.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Bullet Penetration & Light Cover
source_refs.claim: Incorrect asset collision is corrected in batches. The separate calibre/material penetration system has further investigation and improvements planned for 2027; all light-cover reports are not declared fixed.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124236763; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support forwards a follow-up including bullets blocked by apparently invisible barriers. The reply identifies neither the assets nor a common cause with the accompanying truck complaint.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Foliage, LOD & Visual Readability
source_refs.claim: PS5 Pro PSSR is already live; further visual and performance work targets 2.0. QSSR remains future work dependent on Sony availability.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Community Requests / Party Chat
source_refs.claim: Expanded Party Chat is in development for 2.0, subject to completion. This is separate from the party-lobby defects recorded as fixed in 1.2.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Bugs & Issues / Spawn & Asset Replication
source_refs.claim: Developers report reduced frequency after earlier changes and a further fix prepared for the next update. Release of this additional fix and complete recovery are not established.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Bugs & Issues / Foliage, LOD & Visual Readability
source_refs.claim: Further visual-quality, performance and environmental-readability work is ongoing for 2.0. Earlier PSSR and asset improvements are not a universal foliage fix.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Bugs & Issues / DLSS, Frame Generation & Settings
source_refs.claim: A fix for NVIDIA Frame Generation reactivation and disappearing DLSS options is in progress, targeting an update in 2026 without a firm date. No release is announced.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Bugs & Issues / DLSS, Frame Generation & Settings
source_refs.claim: The developer includes disappearing DLSS menu options in work targeting a 2026 update, without a firm release date. Individual GPU-selection workarounds remain separately scoped.

source_refs.title: Dlss
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124137734; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support acknowledges similar reports of the DLSS option disappearing and forwards an RTX 5060 laptop case for investigation. The reporter dates the symptom to Update 1.5; Support does not independently establish onset.

source_refs.title: Community Feedback #9 | Command Post
source_refs.source_locator: Community-Requested Quality-of-Life Changes / Controller Tactical Map & Markers
source_refs.claim: The developer describes marker-placement improvements for 2.0, including overlap handling subject to final testing. This acknowledges the symptom class without establishing the original report’s exact cause or a released fix.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124236763; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support requests diagnostics for the October 31 report of brief lag after leaving water. The reply does not establish a cause or a released fix.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679810651840623; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support continues troubleshooting the performance complaints on November 4. No resolved outcome or internal reproduction is reported.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124236763; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: The same report describes difficulty climbing riverbanks after swimming. Support replies to the mixed report without confirming this symptom as a reproduced defect.

source_refs.title: Bugs and problems still needed to be worked on...
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679173080075775; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: An earlier request for manual gear holding while climbing hills is treated as a suggestion and directed to feedback channels; no transmission change is promised.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679490124236763; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support forwards the follow-up report describing uphill truck gear-hunting and invisible bullet barriers. The response supplies no cause or fix for either symptom.

source_refs.title: Me quedé trabado en un pozo
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679917415821235; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support acknowledges similar reports of players stuck in a well and escalates the November 6 Hue Outskirts report. No fix date is given.

source_refs.title: Poor FPS on a 7900 xtx
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679917415815075; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support acknowledges similar low-FPS reports and requests diagnostics. The reporter subsequently says the suggested shorter corpse timer was already in use.

source_refs.title: Poor FPS on a 7900 xtx
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572680221973558901; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: After receiving diagnostics, Support forwards the RX 7900 XTX low-FPS case for further investigation on November 8. No cause or fix is confirmed.

source_refs.title: Background matrix creeping in
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572680221973585266; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support reviews diagnostics for intermittent dark, patterned sky corruption and asks about installation drives. It does not identify a GPU fault, game defect or fix.

source_refs.title: Something i think it needed to be worked on..
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679770568923706; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support states that changing fire mode does not change bullet damage. Its initial rifle explanation is disputed by the reporter and followed by a correction of context; exact weapon damage is not established by this exchange.

source_refs.title: I have something to ask
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679770568931860; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support identifies the separate weapon-comparison thread as a duplicate of the existing mixed report and asks the author to continue there.

source_refs.title: I have something to ask
source_refs.source_locator: Reply 572679810651839814; original report and surrounding replies reviewed
source_refs.claim: Support says the team is aware of the reported difference between US and NVA rifle performance and is looking into it. The reply specifies neither damage values nor an intended change.

limitations: No independent gameplay testing. Released status means publisher-reported release, not universal player recovery.
The automatic reply monitor completed 47 of 48 tracked threads; broader discovery remains partial, with 81 eligible threads not fully scanned in the inspected run.
The missing keybinding-thread fetch was an unexpected redirect, not proof that the report or bug was deleted.
Only the selected recent reports were substantively reviewed. Unchanged older dossiers retain their evidence dates; silence does not prove persistence or resolution.
Support diagnostic advice or escalation does not establish reproduction, root cause or a working fix.
The duplicate rifle-comparison thread is not independent corroboration. No new Qonzer/IAD or SoulSniper incident was verified.
Catch Up covers selected released changes from October 7–21, reviewed November 9. Community Feedback #9 was reviewed separately and does not extend released-change coverage.
preserved: Existing layout, styles and frontend interaction scripts
All previous issue IDs, evidence history and source dates
All nine released patch entries and their release dates
Private submissions, accounts, moderation and existing collection schedule
